verdict.rationale: A consumer phone service would not normally be judged on job scheduling, but the plans page says users can 'set up automated calls to check on them or remind them as needed', which is the product's own scheduled-automation capability, so the axis applies. That is a single thin mention limited to check-in and reminder calls. It never says the calls can recur, and there is no general workflow scheduling. missing for 10: explicit recurring schedules, general workflow or job automation beyond reminder calls, documentation of how schedules are configured, programmatic or API access (OpenAPI probes returned 404), independent corroboration.
